Must its net heat and net work each be zero?
questions.answer:
Model:
Apply the model for Path Integrals, State Functions, and Path Functions under every condition stated in the question; use SI units unless another unit is explicitly supplied.

Working:

Final result: state-function changes vanish over the cycle, while net heat and net work may both be nonzero and equal under the stated sign convention.
